text:
Welcome to Issue 87. This week's roundup has five links on developer tooling.

The first is a new Rust linter that catches subtle bugs before they reach production. There's also a Git GUI that makes branching, merging, and reviewing commits easier, and a tracing tool for tracking down performance bottlenecks.

There should be something useful here whether you've been doing this for years or are just starting out.

Thanks for being one of our 9,400 subscribers.
